name: HSBC Holdings
title: Interim Results 2026 Equity Analysts Meeting - Transcript

read.thesis: Post-results Q&A reaffirms cost near 'about 1%' target basis and 5% revenue baseline, but gives no new numbers on NII, ECL, or payout; supply-side read is neutral with investment acceleration pulled into 2027.

triggers.label: Costs near 'about 1%' target basis
triggers.quote: we will be near the “about 1%” guidance for costs on a target basis

triggers.label: Loan growth doubled vs prior quarters
triggers.quote: This quarter loan growth was double what we have seen in any of the previous quarters

guidance.quote: we will be near the “about 1%” guidance for costs on a target basis
I feel fairly comfortable from a revenue perspective on using the 5% as a baseline
the baseline of the RoTE we want to drive is 17% or better

red_flags.label: Turkey/Egypt divestment disclosure limited
red_flags.quote: There isn’t further disclosure, but it’s a fairly typical part of the bank

red_flags.label: Hong Kong deposit pricing war
red_flags.quote: there's a bit of a pricing war going on, but we don't really engage on that

evasions.topic: Wealth net new money / sustainable fee growth
evasions.quote: We didn't give any targets, per se, on the wealth
we're not going to do it at any cost
